Shaped iteration 0204: two benchmark tasks that continue the XML independent-key thread from `library-specialty` to the second inventory, `library-icon-tests`.

Why: #873 wrote `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` and confirmed all ten `library-specialty` IDs (`xml keys: 10/10 OK` with both `--inventory` and `--artifact`; the mutation check exits 1). I read `benchmark/cases/dev/library-icon-tests.json` in full. It has ten XML claims (A0001-A0010), `oracle.independent_checker.status: pending` and no cold key yet. Recommendation step 3 of next-gap-0202 covers both inventories.

Graph (`.session/tasks.json`, passes the direct Python field and heading check, exit 0):
- `xml-key-cold-0204` (benchmark, default, medium, 45 min/25 turns): derives the ten values cold from the artifact only and writes `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0204-icon-tests.json`. The fixture, the other keys and the checker are forbidden reads.
- `xml-key-check-0204` (benchmark, default, low, 30 min/20 turns, blocked_by cold): runs the existing checker in both modes and writes nothing. Its verification runs `--inventory`.

Expected gain: `library-icon-tests` goes from 0/10 to 10/10, or the report names each mismatch.

## What next
- After 0204, a permitted writer records the agreements in both fixtures' `oracle.independent_checker`. The same task recomputes every live pin map (`benchmark/writing/input-pins.json`, `benchmark/preparation.json`). A reviewer then checks the changed scope.
- Do not re-derive the `library-specialty` keys or rewrite the checker. The working memory has the details.
